caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored object resembling a decorative urn or chalice mounted on a wide circular base, tapering upward then flaring out again before narrowing at the neck and then expanding into a rounded lid. Emerging from the top of the lid are two cylindrical objects positioned at an angle away from each other, and these are connected to the lid by short chains. The entire drawing is contained within a faintly outlined square centered on a larger, lightly colored background. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a smaller inset line drawing that mirrors the main object in simple outline form, and to the lower left of the main object, there is a small circular mark. The drawing is executed in shades of gray, suggesting it is either a pencil or graphite illustration.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
